answer: The forge I would price into every new account is Proof of unique app crash-report fix record: crashes fixed release by release in one app, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because crashes fixed release by release in one app is bound to a single identity — the jade is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the trellis for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
